mapper.select: SELECT tpd.id AS detailId, tpd.treat_plan_id AS planId, tpd.treat_step_id AS stepId, tpd.type, tpd.tooth_bit AS toothBit, tpd.billing_item_id AS billingItemId, tpd.billing_item_name AS billingItemName, tpd.unit, tpd.price, tpd.quantity, tpd.quantity-tpdw.writeoffQuantity AS enableQuantity, tdpw.writeoffQuantity, CASE WHEN tdpw.writeoffQuantity <= 0 and tpdw.status = 0 THEN 1 WHEN tpdw.writeoffQuantity < tpd.quantity and tpdw.status = 1 THEN 2 WHEN tpdw.writeoffQuantity = tpd.quantity and tpdw.status = 1 THEN 3 WHEN tpdw.writeoffQuantity >= 0 and tpdw.status = 2 THEN 4 AS status, tpd.remark FROM treat_plan_detail tpd LEFT JOIN ( SELECT IFNULL(SUM(write_off_quantity),0) writeoffQuantity, IFNULL(status,0) AS status, plan_detail_id FROM treat_plan_detail_writeoff GROUP BY plan_detail_id ) tpdw ON tpd.id = tpdw.plan_detail_id WHERE treat_plan_id = #{planId}
